reason: Draft agent-guide doc, mostly moved from the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx; the relative paths match the layout next-upgrade.ts copies, so a short summary is enough.
headline: Split different-major agent upgrade guide out of the monolithic guide
summary: Adds the guide the agent follows when an upgrade crosses a major version. It keeps the checklist, codemod, and verify steps from the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx. The duplicate checks and commit/PR steps now live in shared.md, and the guide ends by pointing back to shared.md. The doc is marked draft, and its relative references (../codemods.md, ../version-N.md, shared.md) match the directory layout that next-upgrade.ts copies.
